data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $14,529,000 is an improvement of $12,197,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2018 US and Japan natural catastrophe events
prior_year_events.impact_description: Industry experience indicated marked deterioration in industry loss events; Syndicate's gross loss estimates remained fairly stable.
Improvement of claims reserves established at the prior year end (net improvement of $12,197,000).

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 Dec 2019 the syndicate carried opening gross claims outstanding of $67.73m (balance sheet prior-year figure). The syndicate reports an improvement in prior year reserves with a net release of $12.197m included within 2019 calendar year claims, driven by refined reserving approach and favourable claims development. The syndicate's principal exposure is US windstorm (property/reinsurance), and industry nat-cat experience in 2018/2019 was noted but did not materially increase the syndicate's gross estimates.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $14,529,000 is an improvement of $12,197,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end.

The syndicate has refined its approach this year end in establishing the technical provisions for claims outstanding reserves and reinsurer's share thereof held as compared to the end of the previous year.
The syndicate's current catastrophe exposure is predominantly US windstorm related.
industry experience for the 2018 and 2019 natural catastrophe events in the US and Japan have certainly indicated marked deterioration in the industry loss events.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year reserve movement (gross of reinsurance) not explicitly disclosed. Report states a net improvement of $12.197k (net of reinsurance) which has been used as the prior year development (fallback). Opening reserves derived from Balance Sheet gross claims outstanding. Claims development triangle contains only two underwriting years (2018, 2019) so cannot be used to compute PYD for older years. All amounts reported in native currency (USD).
